name: Ryougoku Ichii
source: The school nurse at Full Bloom Academy. He's a talented pharmacist, the likes of which even the highest ranked academics will admit their admiration of, and is currently working on a number of rather dubious medicines for the school's use. He keeps a few hidden adult videos somewhere, but he's devoted to Kio most of all.
